text:
jordan-support: Heads up — enterprise customer reported invoice showing ~2x token usage for last Thursday during a deploy window. They're sure they didn't increase traffic. They attached sample request_ids: req_8a3f... and req_8a3f... (same client timestamp).

alice-nguyen: thanks, can you paste the sample request headers and the exact invoice lines?

jordan-support: pasted below. invoice: INV-2026-04-18 line item shows 1,200,000 tokens for model/redwood-x-large and dashboard shows 610,432 tokens for the same period. Request sample header (redacted):

```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]
Content-Type: application/json
X-Client-Request-Id: req_8a3f2b4
User-Agent: my-client/2.1
# no X-Idempotency-Key header
```

jordan-support: customer said their client got a 502 intermittently and retried automatically.

omar-keyes: repeating this: if the client retries after a non-idempotent POST without an idempotency key, the gateway will forward both requests and we'll meter both. we saw similar in staging a while back.

kevin-ml: ok — can we confirm this in the ingestion ledger? @billing-ops-bot can you dump ledger rows for that invoice window for that org (org_99)?

billing-ops-bot: exporting ledger rows for org_99 between 2026-04-17T22:00Z and 2026-04-18T02:00Z. CSV link: https://internal/billing/exports/ledger-org_99-20260418.csv (redacted). Summary: 1,198,912 token records, 1,198,912 tokens billed.

alice-nguyen: dashboard query returned ~610k tokens. That suggests ~588k tokens were ingested by ledger but not attributed to dashboard metrics. Need to check where extra entries came from. Possible duplicates from gateway replay or delayed replays from edge proxy.

omar-keyes: looking at proxy logs around the sample req id. Saw two POSTs from same client IP within 1.2s with identical payload id/hash. Gateway assigned different internal request_ids: gw_req_a9c and gw_req_b1d. Both forwarded to inference pool.

kevin-ml: can you paste the relevant log snippet?

omar-keyes: log snippet:

```
[2026-04-18T00:12:34.112Z] gw_req_a9c - client:req_8a3f2b4 - upstream POST /v1/generate -> 502 Bad Gateway (upstream timeout)
[2026-04-18T00:12:34.114Z] gateway -> client: 502
[2026-04-18T00:12:35.320Z] gw_req_b1d - client:req_8a3f2b4 - upstream POST /v1/generate -> 200 OK
[2026-04-18T00:12:35.321Z] gateway -> client: 200
```

omar-keyes: note the client retried after 1.2s and got 200 for the second. Both were forwarded upstream and both produced token metering entries.

jordan-support: customer logs show them retrying on 502 by default (library behavior). They did not set an idempotency key.

alice-nguyen: two possible mitigations: 1) enforce/require `X-Idempotency-Key` for POSTs to generation endpoints (soft enforce with warnings then reject) or 2) gateway-level dedupe for identical payloads within short time window (fingerprint payload + client id). Both have tradeoffs.

kevin-ml: short-term: we should reconcile invoice vs dashboard and issue credit if double-billed. @billing-ops-bot can you run a dedupe check to identify pairs of ledger rows with same client request id / payload hash within 5s?

billing-ops-bot: dedupe check complete. Found 27,432 tokens across 142 request pairs matching same client-request-id and similar payload hash within 5s. Potential duplicated billing amount: 27,432 tokens. Export: https://internal/billing/exports/dedupe-org_99-20260418.csv

omar-keyes: interesting — that's only ~27k tokens, not the full ~588k delta. Where's the rest? Maybe retries from other clients or connection retries aggregated in a downstream batch that got re-ingested. Need to check ingress logs for replay bursts around 00:10–00:30.

alice-nguyen: also check pipeline replay topic: sometimes the ingress kafka partition had a consumer rebalancing and duplicate commits cause reingest. @kevin-ml can you check consumer offsets and any at-least-once replay events?

kevin-ml: checking. Found a consumer restart at 2026-04-18T00:09:58Z for ingestion-worker-7; there was an uncommitted window and we reprocessed ~320k tokens during catch-up that also made it to the ledger. The dashboard stream (used for realtime metrics) dedupes by request_id earlier, but the ledger ingestion is downstream and lacked that dedupe key due to a schema change in March where request_id became optional.

jordan-support: so combination: client retries without idempotency-key + consumer reprocess = large duplicate chunk in ledger but dashboard avoided it because dedupe happened earlier. explains invoice > dashboard.

alice-nguyen: root causes: (A) client libraries retry on 502 w/out idempotency guidance, (B) request_id optionality introduced March makes ledger dedupe blind, (C) consumer restart produced at-least-once reprocess.

omar-keyes: remediation plan: short-term credit customer for confirmed duplicates (billing team to issue credit for 27,432 tokens now, and escalate rest to platform). medium-term: reintroduce required request_id/idempotency_key into ingestion schema and add gateway-side dedupe. long-term: make ledger ingestion idempotent (idempotency-key enforced at ingestion) and improve consumer commit reliability.

kevin-ml: I'll open eng-infra ticket with logs and offsets and assign to ingestion team. Also suggest an automatic reconciler that cross-checks dashboard vs ledger and flags >20% deltas for manual review.

alice-nguyen: billing — please hold off on full credit until platform confirms duplicate chunk size. But go ahead and credit the small confirmed duplicate amount and let customer know we're investigating root cause and will follow up with final reconciliation.

jordan-support: copy that. I'll send a cautious reply to customer: "we've issued a small immediate credit and are investigating a ledger ingestion replay combined with retries; we'll follow up with final reconciliation and platform changes." :thumbsup:

kevin-ml: next actions listed in ticket ENGINFRA-4821: attach logs, kafka offsets, ledger export, recommended schema change (request_id required), and rollout plan for gateway dedupe.

alice-nguyen: thanks all — keep me posted.

jordan-support: closing loop here once billing posts credit and eng infra confirms ticket.
